jobs.title: Engineering Intern
jobs.descriptionText:
Form MattersWho are we?OUR MISSIONTo make the coach-athlete relationship the most powerful and scalable asset in fitness.OUR VISIONA world where every fitness coach — regardless of how many clients they have — coaches with the intelligence, insight, and precision of the best in the world.We are not building another fitness app.We are building the intelligence layer beneath every coaching relationship — making coaches more effective, athletes more seen, and businesses more resilient.What is this job about?We are looking to hire an engineering intern who will help us deliver features for our app. Form matters is a platform that celebrates coaches and aims to reduce the time and effort needed by the coaches to ensure that their athletes become the best version of themselves. We are a young startup, things move fast and you will be working very closely with the co-founders to build and ship features and solve challenges that come along the way. You will be working across design, frontend and backend. We are also an AI-first company, so AI is woven into our work from Day 1.Who are we looking for?We are looking for a person who demonstrates the following qualities:      High agency: you are self-driven and figure out what needs to be done rather than waiting to be told, ready to try and test fail fast and move forwardHigh integrity: You see problems through to a real solution instead of settling for half-measures. If something doesn’t feel right to you, you take steps to make it rightA bias towards delivery and security: “delivered” is better than “perfect”, but “shipped” never means “insecure”. You know where to draw the lineCuriosity: Must not be afraid of trying and learning new things on your ownStrong communicator: most of the team works asynchronously, so good communication skills are required. You should ask questions as much as possible and let the team know of blockers as soon as they appear rather than waiting for someone to come online and ask you if you have any blockersEmpathy: you’re happy to meet the team, client, partner m where they arePro AIWe work with NodeJS, Typescript, Express and Postgres as the main stack. We use AWS as the cloud provider and Docker as the containerization tool. 
What do we offer?      Compensation backed internship for 3/ 6 monthsMeaningful work: your work has a direct impact - 100s of coaches and athletes will use the features built by you.A fast-working environment where we ship features in hours - no bureaucracy and traditional office hierarchies to slow down work.AI first working culture. You will get your own Claude account giving you full access to frontier AI technology. Before beginning any work, we always think: how can we make AI do it faster for us?Opportunity to wear many hats: you will work across design, backend and frontend: we work as a cross-functional team, so there is no business team or engineering team or design team. We all work together where each one does what they are best at, maximising the team’s progress.Chance to grow with the company: statistics show that early employees have a big impact on how the company grows and usually reach higher positions faster.
Applying is simple — no resume, no cover letter. Just answer a few questions and show us something you've built.https://form-matters.co.in/applications/engineering-intern

jobs.title: AI Research Intern
jobs.descriptionText:
Sony Research India is driving cutting-edge research and development in various locations around the globe, including laboratories in Japan, the United States, Europe, and Asia. We endeavor to create new technology, products, and services while sustaining Sony Group’s diverse businesses in electronics, entertainment, and financial fields. For our research center to blaze a trail in the latest technologies, we seek to foster the growth of a diverse pool of research and engineering talent and create a technology talent bank to drive research excellence worldwide. Sony Research India is offering outstanding career opportunities around frontline technologies such as AI and data analytics.We are looking for a highly motivated AI Research Intern to work on user behavior modeling for OTT platforms. The internship focuses on developing value-based models that capture how users perceive and derive value from the platform and leveraging causal inference techniques to identify effective interventions that improve user engagement, retention, and long-term satisfaction.This is an opportunity to work on real-world, business-driven research problems at the intersection of machine learning, causal inference, and user modeling.Work Location:      Remote work within India.
Duration of the paid internship:      The paid internship will be for six months starting third week of August 2026.The working hours are from 9:00 IST to 18:00 IST (Monday to Friday).
Education:      Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a closely related field.
Responsibilities:      Develop predictive models using ML/DL/LLMs to understand and predict user behavior on OTT platforms.Design and build value-based models to quantify the value users derive from different aspects of the platform and content.Apply causal inference techniques to identify factors influencing user engagement and retention and recommend actionable interventions.Develop and evaluate user intervention strategies using counterfactual and causal reasoning approaches.Analyze large-scale user interaction datasets to derive insights and validate modeling hypotheses.Implement and experiment with machine learning and causal inference algorithms using Python and PyTorch.Collaborate with researchers to prototype, evaluate, and deploy novel approaches for user behavior modeling.
Must-Have Skills:      Strong foundation in machine learning, deep learning and LLMs with both theoretical understanding and practical implementation experience.Knowledge of transformers, fine tuning of LLMs etc.Knowledge of working with large-scale datasets and proficiency in SQL for data analysis.Strong programming skills in Python.Ability to read, understand, and implement ideas from recent ML/AI research papers.Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
Good to Have Skills:      Familiarity with causal inference.Experience with user behavior modeling, recommendation systems, or personalization.Familiarity with representation learning, sequential modeling, or reinforcement learning.Experience with LLMs, including fine-tuning or integrating them into downstream applications.Experience working with AWS services such as S3, Athena, and EC2.Ability to rapidly prototype ideas and validate them through experiments.

jobs.title: Software Engineer Intern
jobs.descriptionText:
Branch OverviewBranch is a leading AI-powered lending fintech with 50M+ downloads across India and Africa. We use alternative data and machine learning to expand financial access for millions of people traditionally excluded from the formal financial system. Founded by the former CEO of Kiva.org and backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz, Visa, and the IFC, Branch combines mission-driven impact with world-class technology and scale.In India, Branch operates as a regulated digital lending institution and Middle Layer NBFC, building trusted and accessible financial products for millions of customers across the country. Our 250+ member India team is growing rapidly and works across technology, data science, risk, product, and operations to solve high-impact problems at scale.Certified as a Great Place to Work in 2025, Branch offers the opportunity to build meaningful careers while shaping the future of inclusive fintech in one of the world’s fastest-growing digital economies.Job OverviewAs a company, we are passionate about our customers, fearless in the face of barriers, and driven by data. As an engineering team, we value bottom-up innovation and decentralized decision-making: We believe the best ideas can come from anyone in the company, and we are working hard to create an environment where everyone feels empowered to propose solutions to the challenges we face. We are looking for individuals who thrive in a fast-moving, innovative, and customer-focused setting.About the RoleAs a software engineering intern, you will work closely with experienced engineers at Branch and make significant contributions to our products and code base for 4-6 months. You will brainstorm, design, code, debug, and ship features serving our millions of customers while picking up skills necessary for your career.Responsibilities      Build out functionality for existing and new product lines and platforms such as Credit, Payments, KYC, Data Platforms, etc.Integrate with various third-party systems, including payment systems, identity providers, and messaging platforms.
Qualifications      Have some experience building Backend that are more than just toy projects. Applications that have real users or an open source project would be a great plus.You have a solid foundation in computer science fundamentals, distributed systems, data storage.Know your way through various flavors of Unix and commonly used command line utilities.Proficiency with at least one mainstream language like Python, Ruby, Java, Kotlin, etc.You are highly entrepreneurial. You take the initiative to solve problems before they arise. You’ve started and/or contributed to projects you’re passionate about.You are a great collaborator and communicator. You know that startups are a team sport. You listen to others, speak your mind, and ask the right questions.You are excited by the prospect of working in a distributed team and company, working with teammates from all over the world, and learning.
Benefits of Joining      Mission-driven, fast-paced and entrepreneurial environmentCompetitive stipend as compensationA collaborative and flat company cultureA job offer depending on your performance during the internship
Read our Engineering Blog to learn about our technology, culture, and engineering practices: https://crafted.branch.co/Branch International is an Equal Opportunity Employer. The company does not and will not discriminate in employment on any basis prohibited by applicable law. We’re looking for more than just qualifications -- so if you’re unsure that you meet the criteria, please do not hesitate to apply!
